fn usage(raw: Usage, input: usize, started: Instant, deadline_ms: u64) -> SwiftValidationUsage {
    SwiftValidationUsage {
        input_visible_bytes: input,
        source_bytes: raw.source_bytes,
        metadata_reserved: raw.metadata_reserved,
        scratch_reserved: raw.scratch_reserved,
        metadata_peak_reserved: raw.metadata_peak_reserved,
        scratch_peak_reserved: raw.scratch_peak_reserved,
        total_peak_reserved: raw.total_peak_reserved,
        work_used: raw.work_used,
        elapsed_micros: u64::try_from(started.elapsed().as_micros()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX),
        deadline_ms,
    }

pub(super) struct Metadata<D: Declaration = FrozenDeclaration> {
    pub signatures: Buffer<Signature>,
    pub parameters: Buffer<Type>,
    pub imports: Buffer<Import>,
    pub functions: Buffer<Function>,
    pub globals: Buffer<Global>,
    pub exports: Buffer<Export>,
    pub data: Buffer<Segment>,
    pub elements: Buffer<Segment>,
    pub memory: Option<(u32, u32)>,
    pub table: Option<(u32, u32)>,
    // Preserve declaration form separately from the resolved host maximum.
    pub declarations: D,
    pub instructions: usize,
}
impl<D: Declaration> Metadata<D> {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            signatures: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            parameters: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            imports: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            functions: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            globals: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            exports: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            data: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            elements: Buffer::new(Resource::Metadata),
            memory: None,
            table: None,
            declarations: D::default(),
            instructions: 0,
        }
    }
